revdic.py.summary: Reverse the keys and values of a JSON dictionary in place.
details: Loads the mapping, swaps keys with values, and writes the result back to the same file with two-space indentation and sorted keys.

rm_from_archive.py.summary: Delete a member from a ``.tar.zst`` archive.
details: Streams the archive through zstandard into a temporary tar, drops the requested member, and replaces the original archive with the rebuilt one without disturbing the other entries.

rmc_termux.py.summary: Strip comments and docstrings from Python files with per-file limits and reports.
details: ``-c`` removes ordinary comments, ``-d`` the function/class docstrings, ``-a`` everything (module docstrings and annotations included) and ``--remove-blank-lines`` the empty lines. ``--dry-run``/``--diff`` preview, ``--backup`` keeps a copy, size/token/depth budgets bound the work and ``--report-json`` streams a JSON report.

rmempty.py.summary: Delete the empty files below the current directory.
details: Collects the zero-byte files (``__init__.py`` excluded), lists them and removes them, printing how many were deleted and how many failed.

rmfiles.py.summary: Delete the top-level files named in a list file.
details: Reads ``list.txt`` (or the file given as the argument), deletes the matching files of the current directory, ignores entries that point outside it and finally removes the list file itself.

rmi.py.summary: Remove invisible and bidirectional control characters from text files.
details: Strips zero-width spaces and joiners, non-breaking spaces, soft hyphens, the BOM and the bidi overrides from each text file (default: every non-binary file below the current directory) and reports how many characters went away.

rmlic.py.summary: Remove license header blocks from source files.
details: Loads the known license patterns from ``/sdcard/lic``, deletes the matching blocks (with the surrounding blank lines) from the files below the current directory and reports what changed.

rmshebang.py.summary: Remove the shebang line from Python files.
details: Deletes the first line when it starts with ``#!/`` and rewrites the files in a spawn-based pool, printing the space that was freed.

rprompt.py.summary: Slim Python sources down for pasting into a prompt.
details: Drops the comments and docstrings with :mod:`tokenize` and shortens the local variable names that only occur once, so the file keeps its structure while taking fewer tokens. Files are handled in parallel.
rprompt.py.notes: Rewrites the sources in place, so keep a copy before shrinking a file for a prompt.

Renders the RST with docutils to HTML and then converts that HTML with ``html_to_markdown``, writing the ``.md`` file next to the source and deleting the original. Files are converted in parallel.
rst2md.py.notes: The original ``.rst`` file is removed after a successful conversion.

ruffbin.py.summary: Run ``ruff format`` on the extension-less scripts below the current directory.
details: Walks the tree, skips symlinks and ``.git`` and formats every file without a suffix (the usual Python scripts in a ``bin`` folder) with ruff.

run_pylint.py.summary: Run pylint over Python files with a compact message template.
details: Calls pylint with ``--persistent=n --reports=n --output-format=parseable`` and a ``file:line:column:object:message:id`` template on the given files (directories are expanded) or on every Python file below the current directory.

s16.py.summary: Split text files into chunks of at most ~16 000 characters.
details: Cuts each file at a sentence or line boundary near the ``CHUNKSIZE`` limit (15 850 characters) and writes the parts as separate files, which keeps every chunk inside a model's context window.
